# Camera: This is the quickest way to get the ProSnap Deluxe camera

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_164_nukaknights-post-kamera.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The **Camera** or "**ProSnap Deluxe Camera**" is a very important item in Fallout 76. You need the camera for many **challenges** on the game board and if you feel like it, you can take usable photos with the camera in the game even without the challenges. Not to be confused with photo mode. Photo mode includes various frames, filters, player poses, etc. and is accessible via the map. **Photo mode is not the camera**. The camera is an item listed under weapons and can be equipped through it. Use the “Drag” button to activate the camera’s viewfinder and use the “Attack” button to take a photo.

*Tip: You should first play a few levels and do some looting to collect materials, otherwise you won't be able to set up the terminal and build the camera.*

## Step 1: Activate your personal terminal for free in the Atom Shop

Open the Atom Shop and go to the “C.A.M.P.” section, from there to “Useful Information”. There you will find the “Personal Terminal”.

![Atom Shop: Personal Terminal for free](/uploads/nukaknights-kamera-atom-shop.jpg) 

## Step 2: Set up a personal terminal in the CAMP

Required resources:

- Aluminum: 4
- Rubber: 2
- Copper: 2
- Circuits: 2

![Personal Terminal: Required Construction Materials](/uploads/nukaknights-kamera-persoenliches-terminal-camp.jpg) 

## Step 3: Activate side quest

If you have set up the Personal Terminal, use it and select the item: "**Automatic notifications**"

As the next point, select “**Suspicious person**” and download the **coordinates**.

Now you have a new task under **Side Quests -> Other**: “**Take a closer look at the suspicious person**”.

At this point you now select “Show on map”, on PC this is the “C” key.

Now the position of the tourist will be marked on the map. This position is different on each server. This can e.g. be at the Palace of the Hidden Path, or at the water park, or at the mining monument, or Whitespring, etc. The important thing is that you can find this location via a marker on each server. Now all you have to do is get there.

*Tip: If you are still at a low level, join public teams with 3 other players. There you can travel to their camps for free and unlock the locations. You can also take part in any public event for free and unlock the locations there.* 

![Personal Terminal: Automatic Notifications](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-15-58-59.jpg)

![Personal Terminal: Suspicious Person](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-15-59-05.jpg)

![Personal Terminal: Download coordinates](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-15-59-13.jpg)

![Side quests: Other: Examine the suspicious person](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-15-59-38.jpg)

## Step 4: Visit the tourist

Now you take the holotape, the note and the broken ProSnap Deluxe camera from the tourist. This will activate the **side quest “Last Wishes”** where your first task is to make the camera.

![Tourist Anne with the camera Quest Last Wishes](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-16-00-53.jpg)

![Camera Quest: Last Wishes](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-16-01-04.jpg)

![Camera Quest: Last Wishes -> Craft Camera](/uploads/fallout-76-21.05.2023-16-01-18.jpg)

## Step 5: Craft the camera at a crafting workbench

If you already have the blueprint for the **crafting workbench**, craft the camera in your camp, otherwise there are crafting workbenches in Rusty Pick, in other players' camps, at several train stations, in Nuka World on Tour or in Whitespring that you can use to craft the camera.
